entries.public_description: Middle-aged man who hired your party in Ashwood. He hired you to steal Alric's Locket.

entries.title: Orman Harrington Request
entries.public_description: My brother passed several years ago. He was a crafter. He made jewelry. This is all I have left of his. This was stolen by an influential elf, a powerful mage I suspect. The guards do not help when it involves mages or the connected. His name is Alric. He has gifted the locket to someone of far less means — her name is Gilda. I suspect his wife would not like to know about her.
Slender, with sharp elven features. Dresses in elegant green and gold finery embroidered with thorn motifs. Speaks in rhymes; constantly amused.

entries.title: The Theft
entries.public_description: Stumpy pretended to lose his balance, tripping into a waitress and pulling her blouse down. Olga spat her drink over a flame. Lysander tried to lift the necklace, failed, and ended up ripping it off her neck. Guards and a priestess noticed. Lysander ran, but not before getting a firebolt to his ass.

entries.title: Caught
entries.public_description: The party fled town and made it to a village several days away. They awoke the next day to three people in their room: Alric, Virelle, and Sylwen. Virelle demanded they be executed but Alric thought that was too dull. He sent them to his sisters as he put it — banishment to the fey wilds. Stumpy was given a bottle of ale that Alric never asked to be returned.
